urdu transliteration: Muhammad ka gharana Karbala waale bayaban mein\nQayamat ki faza chhaayi hai Zahra ke gulistan mein
english translation text: Muhammad's noble family stands in the barren desert of Karbala,\nA sorrow like Doomsday has settled upon Zahra's garden.

urdu transliteration: Zameen-e-Karbala isko zara aaraam se rakhna\nSulaya hai Ali Asghar ko sheh ne tere daaman mein
english translation text: O land of Karbala, place him gently, let him rest in peace\nAli Asghar has been laid by the Imam within your embrace.

urdu transliteration: Kahaan ho tum Ali Akbar zara awaaz de dena\nAkeela reh gaya hai Fatima ka laal maidaan mein
english translation text: Where are you, Ali Akbar? Call out, let your voice be heard\nFatima's son now stands alone upon the battlefield.

urdu transliteration: Jo loota Karbala mein to Musalmanoun ne kya loota\nAli ki betiyon ki chadarain aayi hain saamaan mein
english translation text: What did the Muslims plunder in Karbala—what did they truly take?\nThe daughters of Ali returned with only torn veils as their belongings.

urdu transliteration: Jise aaraam milta tha faqat baap ke seene pe\nBhatakti hai kahaan jaane woh gulzaar-e-shaheedaan mein
english translation text: The child who found comfort only upon his father's chest\nNow wanders, lost somewhere in the garden of the martyrs.

urdu transliteration: Agar maan ko Ali Asghar ke marne ki khabar hoti\nKafan chhota sa le aati woh ghar se apne saamaan mein
english translation text: If Asghar's mother had known her infant had been slain,\nShe would have brought a tiny shroud from her home to wrap him.

urdu transliteration: Tere chehre pe ae Zainab jo sadiyon ki thakan dekhe\nNahin hai hausla aaj yeh shehzadi teri maa mein
english translation text: O Zainab, whoever sees the centuries of sorrow upon your face\nKnows your mother's strength cannot bear such grief today.

urdu transliteration: Suno Baba Ali Mushkil Kusha ab to chale aao\nSada deti hai Zainab be-rida Shaam-e-Ghareebaan mein
english translation text: Listen, O father Ali, Helper of the distressed—come now,\nZainab calls out to you, bare-headed, in the night of Shaam-e-Ghareebaan.

urdu transliteration: Muhammad ke gharane pe yeh kaisa imtihaan aaya\nAli Murtaza ki betiyaan aur qaid zindaan mein
english translation text: What trial has descended upon the house of Muhammad?\nThe daughters of Ali Murtaza stand imprisoned behind cold bars.
